alex_support: FYI escalation from AcmePay (ticket #4321). They hit a GitHub OAuth flow failure — our callback returns a 403 with 'state mismatch'. Customer reports intermittent success (about 1/5 attempts). They attached a failing callback URL that shows the `state` param truncated.
alex_support: Example failing callback they sent:
```
GET /auth/callback?code=gho_ABC123&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhY21lIiwiaWF0IjoxNjg...TRUNCATED
```
They say the original state is ~86 chars; in our ingress logs it arrived as ~44 chars.
marta_eng: thanks — can you paste the raw ingress access log line (exact query string) and the GitHub redirect URL from their browser devtools? also which edge we route through (cloudfront/cf worker/ingress nginx)?
alex_support: Ingress is through our CF worker -> LB -> nginx pool. Raw access log (edge) for failing attempt:
```
172.20.10.8 - - [14/Jun/2024:09:12:41 +0000] "GET /auth/callback?code=gho_ABC123&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhY21lIiwiaWF0IjoxNjg... HTTP/1.1" 403 87
```
Browser devtools on their side (failing request) shows full state in Location header before redirect, but callback URL arriving to our edge is truncated.
marta_eng: sounds like something between GitHub and our edge is rewriting/querystring-truncating. Two likely suspects: (1) a Cloudflare Worker that rewrites paths and re-encodes query strings incorrectly, (2) an NGINX `proxy_buffer_size` / `large_client_header_buffers` problem trimming header/query when url contains certain chars. Both have caused similar truncation before.
marta_eng: can we reproduce locally by sending a redirect with a long base64-like state? try:
```
curl -v "https://app.redwood-staging.com/auth/callback?code=gho_TEST&state=$(python -c 'import base64;print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b"x"*80).decode())')"
```
ben_infra: I grabbed CF worker logs for that time window. There's a worker that does simple rewrite to strip a prefix and then reconstructs the URL with `decodeURIComponent`/`encodeURI` — we had a bug where `encodeURI` drops certain characters when used incorrectly. Snippet:
```
// problematic worker code
let url = new URL(request.url);
let newPath = url.pathname.replace('/app', '');
let newUrl = url.origin + newPath + '?' + decodeURIComponent(url.search.substring(1));
return fetch(newUrl, request);
```
This will double-decode and can trim/munge querystrings containing `%2B`/`%2F`/+ characters. That matches base64 urlsafe state patterns.
ben_infra: quick repro I ran via worker local harness showed state length shortened from 88 -> 44 when worker used decodeURIComponent like above.
alex_support: ugh. Customer is on strict PKCE validation so state mismatch -> immediate 403. Any hotfix we can do without a code deploy to backend?
marta_eng: short term: stop doing decode/encode in the worker and forward the original request.url to origin, e.g. `fetch(request)` after adjusting only pathname via URL object but keeping search intact. Example fix:
```
let url = new URL(request.url);
url.pathname = url.pathname.replace('/app', '');
let outReq = new Request(url.toString(), request);
return fetch(outReq);
```
This preserves raw search/query without double decodes.
ben_infra: I'll patch the worker now and roll to the edge with immediate effect (no backend deploy). Also increasing `proxy_buffer_size` on nginx to 128k in case any upstream edge mangles it later. Will post deploy IDs.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: cf-worker/redirect-rewrite v20240614-pt1 -> canary (edge region us-east-1). CI job 3421. :arrow_up:
ben_infra: CF worker patch rolled to canary, observed incoming request now shows full state 88 chars in our worker logs. NGINX buffer bumped in staging; no truncation there.
sam_cse: I emailed customer with a short explanation and asked them to retry right now and to capture network devtools if they still see issues. suggested they try an incognito window as well.
alex_support: Customer retried — reports success: OAuth flow completed and tokens issued. They did 10 attempts and all succeeded. Reopening ticket to monitor for 24h and then we'll close.
marta_eng: root cause summary (for postmortem): CF worker rewrite incorrectly used `decodeURIComponent` on `search` and reconstructed URL by concatenation which caused double-decoding / truncation of urlsafe-base64-ish state strings. Fix: preserve `request.url`'s search or use URLSearchParams safely; added a unit test that sends long states and verifies roundtrip length. Also added canary guard to rollback if rate of failures increases.
alex_support: marking internal incident -> low severity. I'll update ticket #4321 and close once stable for 24h. great cross-team response, thanks everyone :clap:
